ac.title: Infrared air conditioner
ac.description: The infrared emitter sits on one of the two PWM outputs of controller {controller}: choose the channel it is wired to and the unit's brand. On save, the integration checks that the firmware sends air conditioner frames (2.0.4e or later).

data_description.ir_output: Controller channel the SmartBeam emitter is wired to.
data_description.temperature_sensor: Shown as the current temperature on the thermostat. The unit does not report its temperature over infrared.
data_description.skip_firmware_check: On save, the integration queries the controller firmware with command 32. Tick only if the controller is off right now.

ac_model.title: Remote control model
ac_model.description: {brand} uses different protocols depending on the remote control. Choose the code printed on the remote or on the label inside the battery cover.

confirm_delete_ac.title: Confirm deletion
confirm_delete_ac.description: Delete the air conditioner {name}? Its device and entities will be removed.

data.confirm: I confirm deleting this air conditioner

tv.title: Infrared TV (beta)
tv.description: The infrared emitter sits on one of the two PWM outputs of controller {controller}. Choose the remote model and the emitter channel. The TV gets a remote entity (remote.send_command with the key name) and one button per key: everyday keys are enabled; digits and media keys come disabled and can be enabled on the device page. Codes vary by model: check the keys on your TV.

data_description.ir_output: Controller channel where the SmartBeam emitter is wired.
data_description.skip_firmware_check: On save, the integration queries the controller firmware with command 32. Check only if the controller is off right now.

confirm_delete_tv.title: Confirm deletion
confirm_delete_tv.description: Delete TV {name}? Its device and entities will be removed.

window.title: Motorized window
window.description: The window uses the Electric window scenario of the {controller} controller firmware (2.0.9b or later): a pair of inputs, the odd one opens and the even one closes, and one output per direction. The firmware limits the motor run time, never runs both directions together and honors the limit switch. Home Assistant drives the same outputs, with the same protections as the wall buttons. The position is estimated from the travel time and becomes known after one full open or close.

data_description.open_input: Wall buttons wired to the inputs: the first opens, the second closes. A press while the motor runs stops it.
data_description.travel_time: Time the motor takes from fully closed to fully open. Used to estimate the position. When the inputs are configured on the controller, the maximum motor run time is the travel time + 5 s.
data_description.source: Read from the controller: use the scenario already stored, e.g. by SCA Command. Configure now: write both inputs as Electric window with the outputs below. Without querying: just register, with the outputs below.
data_description.open_output: Used when configuring the inputs now or when registering without querying.
data_description.close_output: Used when configuring the inputs now or when registering without querying.

confirm_delete_window.title: Confirm deletion
confirm_delete_window.description: Delete the window {name}? Its device and entity will be removed. The input configuration on the controller does not change.

error.channel_already_configured: This channel already has a configured meter.
error.factor_must_be_positive: The factor must be greater than zero.
error.firmware_no_segments: This controller's firmware has infrared but cannot send air conditioner frames. Update to 2.0.4e or later.
error.firmware_no_ir: This controller's firmware has no infrared command (32). Update to 2.0.4e or later.
error.controller_no_response: The controller did not answer within 5 seconds. Check that it is on and connected to the broker, or tick Register without checking the firmware.
error.window_not_configured: The two inputs of the pair are not configured as Electric window on the controller. Configure them with SCA Command or choose Configure the inputs on the controller now.
error.window_bad_outputs: The window scenario on the controller does not have one output per direction, or uses the same output for both. Fix it with SCA Command or configure the inputs now.
error.window_same_output: Choose different outputs to open and to close.
error.window_inputs_in_use: This input pair already belongs to another window.
error.window_write_failed: The controller did not confirm saving the scenarios. Check that the firmware is 2.0.9b or later.
